items.title: How PGSimCity Turns PostgreSQL Complexity Into a Virtual City 3D Simulation
items.blurb: Nikolay Samokhvalov has developed PGSimCity, an open-source educational tool that visualises PostgreSQL mechanics as a 3D spatial simulation in the browser.

items.title: AWS Introduces Native Vector Search for DynamoDB
items.blurb: Amazon DynamoDB recently introduced native vector search, allowing developers to store embeddings alongside application data and run approximate nearest-neighbor queries directly from DynamoDB without using a separate vector database.
